ana: FYI — ACME just opened an enterprise request: they need 7-year audit retention + BYOK in us-gov-west. Ticket: https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-2048. Need scope, launch criteria, and a rough implementation estimate. TL;DR: customer requires keys they control + exportable, signed audit evidence for seven years. Thoughts?

eli: Quick clarifying Qs — do they want cross-region replication for the archive, or is single-region GovCloud OK? Also, are we doing BYOK as a KMS handshake only (we never hold plaintext) or do they expect import/escrow?

mike: Security POV: BYOK in GovCloud implies HSM-backed KMS and strict custody controls. We must not allow admin-level key export from customer side. If they ask for escrow, that's a separate legal/SLA process (we'll need HSM escrow agreement + restricted ops). Also: retention + export needs an immutable chain-of-custody and tamper-evident manifests.

jamie: Legal: 7yrs is fine but we need a retention-hold API for legal/e-discovery (ability to freeze records). Export format needs to preserve provenance metadata (user, tenant, timestamp, event-hash). We'll need to standardize the manifest schema for downstream legal requests.

sam: Eng/infra: Storage + egress costs for per-token audit logs at 7yrs will be non-trivial. Proposal: implement retention tiers with cold archival (S3 Glacier-like) and per-request rehydration. Also add rate limits / export job queuing. Implementation plan: retention policy + export worker + BYOK handshake layer. Likely a 2-sprint MVP + infra provisioning.

eli: From SE acceptance side — propose the following acceptance criteria: 1) BYOK handshake documented & automated for supported KMS providers, 2) Export API returns NDJSON of events with signed manifest (sha256 hashes + signature), 3) Retention buckets configurable per-tenant, 4) Retention hold/unhold APIs. Example payload for a retention request: ```json
{
  "tenant_id": "acme-corp",
  "retention_months": 84,
  "kms_provider": "aws-gov-kms",
  "export_format": "ndjson+sig"
}
```

ana: Proposed MVP scope: a) retention buckets (90d, 365d, archival 7yr) b) export API with signed manifests (NDJSON + manifest.sig) c) BYOK handshake for customer KMS (AWS GovCloud KMS, Azure Key Vault support) d) retention-hold API. Exclude for MVP: full HSM escrow offering (opt-in enterprise add-on), live-query on archived data, and per-token cost optimizations (we'll handle later).

mike: Risk notes: we need to map this to SOC2 controls (logs & retention), update our threat model for export jobs, and require HSM attestation/certs for GovCloud KMS integrations. Also flag: potential legal export restrictions for cross-border replication — confirm region boundaries.
